TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Settings.Position.Name: Display position
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Settings.Position.Hint: The screen corner where the hover art shows. Each user can drag the hover art to an own position and size instead (see "Use my dragged position and size").
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Settings.MaxHeight.Name: Maximum height (% of screen)
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Settings.MaxHeight.Hint: The hover art keeps its aspect ratio and is never taller than this part of the screen height.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Settings.BackgroundColor: The color behind the hover art and its caption, in the form #rrggbbaa (the last two digits are the opacity). Use the slider to set the opacity.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Settings.ShowBorder.Name: Show border
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Settings.ShowBorder.Hint: Draw a border around the hover art.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Settings.BorderWidth.Hin: The width of the border, if the border shows.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Settings.BorderColor.Hin: The color of the border, in the form #rrggbbaa (the last two digits are the opacity). Use the slider to set the opacity.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Settings.HideDelay.Name: Hide delay (ms)
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Settings.HideDelay.Hint: The hover art shows at once when the pointer enters a token. It hides this long after the pointer leaves the token. Use 0 to hide it at once.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Settings.DefaultFilter.H: The file name filter for a new gallery folder when no filter is typed. Use glob syntax: "*.png", "hero-*.webp", or "{*.png,*.webp}" for more than one type. The match is case-sensitive.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Settings.OwnersManageGal: On: owners of an actor can add and remove images and folders in its gallery. Off: only GMs can manage galleries. Owners can still select the hover art of their tokens from the gallery. Changing this setting reloads all clients.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Settings.HotbarShortcuts: Users can drag a category, an image, or the hover art button of the Token HUD to the hotbar. A shortcut is a script macro, so players need the core permission "Use Script Macros".
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Settings.ShowName.Name: Show token name
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Settings.ShowName.Hint: Show the token name below the hover art. The name shows only if the user can see the token nameplate.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Settings.UseCustomPositi: Use my dragged position and size

Hold the move key (default: Ctrl, see Configure Controls) while the hover art shows. Drag it to move it, or drag a corner handle to resize it. The position and size apply only to you. Turn this off to use the corner and the maximum height again.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Settings.Enabled.Name: Show hover art
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Show the hover art on this computer. This setting applies only to you.
Move or resize the hover art
Hold this key while the hover art shows. The hover art stays open: drag it to move it, or drag a corner handle to resize it.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Gallery.Title: Hover Art Gallery
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Gallery.Hint: All tokens of this actor share this gallery. Select the hover art of each token in the Token HUD (right-click the token).
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Gallery.Empty: No images. Add an image below.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Gallery.Browse: Pick a file. It goes into the field; click Add to add it.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Gallery.BrowseUpload: Pick or upload a file. It goes into the field; click Add to add it.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Gallery.NoBrowsePermissi: You do not have the permission to browse files. Type a path, or ask the GM to add the image.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Gallery.AlreadyAdded: This image is already in the gallery.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Gallery.DefaultSecretHin: New tokens of this actor start with secret hover art. Only GMs and owners see secret hover art.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Folders.Title: Folders
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Folders.NoMatches: No files in this folder match the filter.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Folders.Browse: Pick a folder. It goes into the field; click Add to add it.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Folders.NewFilterTooltip: File name filter for this folder. Empty means the default filter.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Folders.Hint: All images in the folder that match the filter join the gallery. Subfolders are not included. The gallery scans the folder again when a user with the file browser permission opens it.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Folders.FilterTooltip: File name filter. Change it to scan the folder again.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Folders.RescanChanged: The folder scan found changes. The gallery is updated.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Folders.RescanUnchanged: The folder scan found no changes.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Folders.AlreadyAdded: This folder with this filter is already in the gallery.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Folders.FilterHasSlash: The filter applies to file names only. Remove the "/" from the filter.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Folders.ScanFailed: Cannot scan these folders: {folders}. They keep their last file list. Check that the folders exist, then scan again.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Picker.Title: Hover Art: {name}
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Picker.SecretOn: Only GMs and owners see it
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Picker.CategoryEmpty: This category is empty. Drag an image onto its tile, or use "Move to…" in the menu of the image.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Picker.DeleteCategories: This also deletes the categories in it ({count}).
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Picker.DeleteImages: The images in it ({count}) go back to the gallery. No image leaves the gallery.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Hotbar.Disabled: The GM turned hotbar shortcuts off. Ask the GM to turn on "Hotbar shortcuts" in the module settings.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Hotbar.NoScriptPermissio: A hover art shortcut is a script macro. You need the core permission "Use Script Macros". Ask the GM for it.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Hotbar.InvalidShortcut: This macro has no valid hover art shortcut. Drag a new shortcut from the hover art picker.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Hotbar.TokenMissing: The token of this shortcut no longer exists. Drag a new shortcut from the hover art picker.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Hotbar.CategoryMissing: The category of this shortcut no longer exists. The picker shows the whole gallery.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Errors.TokenMissing: The token no longer exists. Open the hover art from the Token HUD of a token.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Errors.NotOwner: You do not own this token, so you cannot change its hover art. Ask the GM for ownership.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Errors.NotInGallery: This image is no longer in the gallery of the actor. Select another image.
TOKEN_HOVER_ART.Errors.NoActor: This token has no actor, so it has no gallery and no categories. Link the token to an actor.
